|---|---|---|
| Pseudomonas aeruginosa | 811 | detected |

| Enterococcus faecalis | 6457 | detected |
| Staphylococcus aureus | 54 | detected |
| Salmonella enterica | 4 | missed (below 10) |

| Listeria monocytogenes | no S-rank row | missed |
| Saccharomyces cerevisiae | no S-rank row | missed |

Listeria, Saccharomyces and Cryptococcus have no species-level row in the report at all, so they count as missed with 0 reads. The report may still place them at a higher rank, but the criterion only uses species-level counts.
